I am a PhD student in the [Knight Campus graduate
program](https://accelerate.uoregon.edu) at the University of Oregon,
where I study how mechanical cues from the extracellular matrix shape
gene expression in the vertebrate gut. I work mostly in R and Python,
and everything on this site - including the site itself - is built from
plain-text Quarto documents kept under version control.

## Education

**PhD, Bioengineering** (in progress)

## Interests

Mechanobiology · host-microbe interactions · single-cell genomics ·
